page_title: BET 2-2 BAR | Betis v Barcelona 07/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Good movement by Youssouf Sabaly (Betis), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
90+7' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
90+7' Barcelona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+7' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away. The ball is out of play and Barcelona manage to earn a corner.
90+6' One of the Betis players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. Barcelona get a free kick.

90+4' 2 - 2 Assane Diao (Betis) meets a perfect cross from Aitor Ruibal deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 2:2.
90+2' Isco (Betis) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
90+2' Marc Casado (Barcelona) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. It's a free kick to Betis, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' Alejandro Ruiz shows the yellow card to Hector Fort (Barcelona) for a heavy challenge.
88' Substitution. Alejandro Balde did his best and is replaced by Hector Fort (Barcelona).
86' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Abde Ezzalzouli will be replaced by Jesus Rodriguez (Betis).
86' Chimy Avila (Betis) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Inaki Pena stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
82' 1 - 2 Ferran Torres (Barcelona) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
82' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Barcelona players have a reason to celebrate!
82' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Alejandro Ruiz is going to take a look using VAR.
82' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) has a goal ruled out for offside!
81' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
80' Betis concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Barcelona have a free kick.
78' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) is caught offside!
77' It's time for a substitution. Assane Diao (Betis) comes on in place of Vitor Roque.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Isco (Betis) will replace Mateo Flores.
74' Hansi Flick has decided to make a change. Pau Victor (Barcelona) replaces Robert Lewandowski.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gavi (Barcelona) is coming onto the pitch as Pedri cannot continue after picking up an injury.
74' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
72' Manuel Pellegrini is forced to make a change. Romain Perraud is unable to continue due to injury, Aitor Ruibal (Betis) comes on.
68' 1 - 1 GOAL! Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) sends the penalty kick into the right of the net.
67' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
66' Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game and punishes the behaviour of Hansi Flick (Barcelona) with a red card.
66' The foul by Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Alejandro Ruiz.
66' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Betis!
65' There's a break in play and referee Alejandro Ruiz must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Betis using VAR. This could be interesting!
63' PENALTY APPEAL by Betis, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
62' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
61' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
60' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Dani Olmo is replaced by Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona).
60' Substitution. Raphinha walks off the pitch and Ferran Torres (Barcelona) comes on as a substitute.

59' A short pass finds Giovani Lo Celso (Betis). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
58' The foul by Romain Perraud (Betis) was seen by Alejandro Ruiz who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Barcelona have a free kick.

57' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) covers his face with his hands after spurning a great chance. The ball rebounded to him but his close-range header went a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
57' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.

56' Marc Casado (Barcelona) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Alejandro Ruiz blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Betis are awarded a free kick.
55' The resulting corner from Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) is cleared.

54' Chimy Avila (Betis) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
54' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
53' Mateo Flores (Betis) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Ruiz saw the whole situation. Barcelona will take a free kick near the side line.

51' The free kick finds Sergi Altimira (Betis) in space in the box, but he can't keep his header down and sends it just wide of the right post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
50' A player from Barcelona commits a rough challenge. Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Betis are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
49' Alejandro Ruiz couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) and blew his whistle. Betis have a free kick.
48' The attendance for today's match is 54749.
48' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

47' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
46' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Marc Bartra (Betis) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
45+1' Marc Bartra (Betis) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

44' Raphinha (Barcelona) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Barcelona.
43' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
43' Pedri (Barcelona) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.

39' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Jules Kounde slips the ball through to Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent low shot into the back of the net. He makes it 0:1.
38' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
37' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
36' Pedri (Barcelona) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
35' A yellow card for a tackle by Mateo Flores (Betis). Alejandro Ruiz doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
34' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
33' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
31' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is penalised for a foul. Alejandro Ruiz had a clear view and blows his whistle. A free kick to Betis.
31' The referee blows his whistle as Marc Bartra (Betis) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a free kick to Barcelona, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
30' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Giovani Lo Celso (Betis). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
27' Alejandro Ruiz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Chimy Avila (Betis). Barcelona win a free kick.

26' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
25' Raphinha (Barcelona) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
25' Sergi Altimira (Betis) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
24' Vitor Roque (Betis) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
22' A crossfield pass from Dani Olmo (Barcelona) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
21' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Betis are awarded the free kick.
21' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
19' Chimy Avila (Betis) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Barcelona.
18' A cross into the box from Chimy Avila (Betis) is cleared.

16' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the right-hand post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
15' A pass from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is intercepted by Francisco Vieites and the move breaks down.
14' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
14' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) tackles a bit over-zealously and Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul. Barcelona win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
12' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Betis.
12' Barcelona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
10' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for an infringement. Free kick. Barcelona will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

10' Ambitious effort from Vitor Roque (Betis). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
9' Vitor Roque (Betis) is moving okay again after that injury scare.

8' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Francisco Vieites pulls off a brilliant save.
5' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Francisco Vieites comes off the line to clear the ball away.
5' Vitor Roque (Betis) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
4' Inaki Pena comes off his line to intercept the corner from Giovani Lo Celso (Betis).
4' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. Betis force a corner. They send men into the box.

3' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Inaki Pena makes a great save to stop the effort going into the right side of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Betis have been awarded a corner kick.
2' Diego Llorente (Betis) meets the corner with a powerful well-placed header that beats the keeper, but the close-range effort is superbly blocked on the goal line by a defender. Unlucky!
2' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) steps up to send the ball in.

2' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Betis have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
1' The corner is swung in but Betis can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
1' Chimy Avila (Betis) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Betis.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Betis will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Alejandro Ruiz.
